info.name: BlueConic REST API v2 Audit Events Reporting API

params.name: dialogueId
params.description: Specifies the dialogue IDs to return the statistics for.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Specifies the startDate of the reporting period. Defaults to 30 days ago if not specified. Format is yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Specifies the endDate of the reporting period. Defaults to today if not specified. Format is yyyy-MM-dd.

params.name: excludeControlGroup
params.description: Whether or not to exclude the control group statistics in the response.

params.name: addRatio
params.description: Specifies the additional ratios to return in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves all statistics for the given dialogues
